verdict.rationale: Mercury bundles banking, spend management (virtual cards, controls), bill pay (AI bill reading, invoicing/AR), accounting sync (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite), and expense/receipt automation into one platform, directly replacing point solutions like Bill.com, Ramp/Brex, and separate AR tools. Community evidence corroborates heavy real-world use across cards, accounts, and payments as a full banking+spend stack, though some friction (mass card cancellation) was noted.
